mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(e.id) AS exam_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(sf.submission_count, 0)), 0) AS submission_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(sf.pending_review_count, 0)), 0) AS pending_review_submission_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL AND e.status != 'DRAFT' AND e.end_time <= NOW() AND e.results_released_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(sf.ungraded_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS releasable_exam_count FROM courses c LEFT JOIN exams e ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.exam_id, SUM(s.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', 'GRADED')) AS submission_count, SUM(s.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', 'GRADED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM questions q LEFT JOIN answers a ON a.question_id = q.id AND a.submission_id = s.id WHERE q.exam_id = s.exam_id AND q.question_type = 'SHORT_ANSWER' AND (a.grading_status IS NULL OR a.grading_status != 'REVIEWED' OR a.teacher_score IS NULL) )) AS pending_review_count, SUM(s.status != 'GRADED') AS ungraded_count FROM submissions s GROUP BY s.exam_id ) sf ON sf.exam_id = e.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY c.id, c.course_name ORDER BY c.id
